description: This file defines a Swift enumeration 'NetworkInterfaceIPv4' with a nested 'AddressEntry' struct and a static method 'addresses()' that retrieves IPv4 network interface addresses using low-level system calls.

classes.name: AddressEntry
classes.description: A structure representing a network interface's name and associated IPv4 address.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active non-loopback IPv4 network interfaces, returning their names and IP addresses.
